data.text: Hey everyone, how about we each catch 10 tons this month? That gives each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons to double back to 100 for next month. If we stick to that, we can keep earning the same amount month after month instead of draining the lake. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check that we're all keeping the agreement. John, would you be willing to commit to 10 tons?
